Nimmanhaemin

Stay here if the Old City feels too early. Soi 9 and the maze west of Nimman are the evening grid.

WhoStudents, remote workers, dinner people
MoveGrab or a 15-minute songthaew from the moat
StaySmall hotels and apartment-style rooms

Maya and One Nimman are the mall anchors. The better bowls are in the sois, not on the main road.
